# Mod Information:
This mod brings back the removed Copper Horn items introduced in a Minecraft Bedrock Edition 1.19 Previews.

- Adds 10 Copper Horn items 
- Brings back 2 removed Goat Horn items (Fly and Resist)
- Adds crafting recipe for Copper Horns
- Copper Horn sounds can be played through /playsound commands

![Goat Horn and Copper Horn Diagram](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec1d947067bd28052bb0c9e8c72dcdba177f2895.png)

# Copper Horn Crafting Recipe Mappings:
1. Ponder --> Great Sky Falling
2. Sing --> Old Hymn Resting
3. Seek --> Pure Water Desire
4. Feel --> Humble Fire Memory
5. Admire --> Dry Urge Anger
6. Call --> Clear Temper Journey
7. Yearn --> Fresh Nest Thought
8. Dream --> Secret Lake Tear
9. Fly --> Fearless River Gift
10. Resist --> Sweet Moon Love

![Copper Horn Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc301edf5998bb31328a14cd64b0be67a751ea08_0.webp)



# Partial Copper Horns
Cheaper Copper Horns that can play only one sound based on how the Partial Copper Horns were crafted.
- Harmony Partial Copper Horns
- Melody Partial Copper Horns
- Bass Partial Copper Horns
